messages:
Raj (Acme Procurement): Hi team — finance won't approve the invoice until the official Order Number is on file. They need a customer PO or an 'Official Order Number' field populated. Invoice INV-2026-4512 for $48,500 is stuck.

Jamie (Support): Thanks for flagging, Raj. Can you confirm whether Acme can accept a pro-forma invoice in the meantime, or do they require the final tax invoice format?

Raj (Acme Procurement): They insist on a formal order number from the vendor side. Our AP requires the PO field to match the supplier record before we can process. No pro-forma — must be a billable invoice with order number.

Emma (Billing): Got it. Our standard practice is to include a PO field when supplied by the customer. We don't generate a customer PO on our side. If they give us the order number string we can reissue the invoice with that field and new invoice date.

Tom (Sales): Raj — can you paste the exact text your AP needs in the PO field? Sometimes they need the prefix like `ACME-PO-2026-0789` vs just a numeric string. Saves us back-and-forth.

Raj (Acme Procurement): They require the full identifier: `ACME-PO-2026-0789`. Also they need supplier tax details (VAT ID) on the invoice for cross-border compliance. Can you include Redwood VAT: EU-REDACT-9981?

Jamie (Support): Thanks. Two quick checks from billing side: 1) We can reissue INV-2026-4512 as a corrected invoice with the PO field and VAT ID included. 2) We cannot backdate invoices; the new invoice will have a new invoice number. Is that ok for Acme?

Raj (Acme Procurement): New invoice number is fine as long as the PO is present and matches our system. They do want `Order number` labeled explicitly on the invoice, not buried in the description.

Emma (Billing): Understood. I'll create a revised invoice: will include `Order number: ACME-PO-2026-0789`, Redwood VAT ID, and supplier address. Also note: because the original payment terms were Net30, the date will reset to the reissue date.

Tom (Sales): Quick heads up — if Acme requires an invoice dated before the contract start for internal matching, that's a finance policy question. We may escalate to accounts payable for an exception, but prefer to reissue with current date.

Raj (Acme Procurement): Reissue with current date is fine. Can you provide the new invoice number and a PDF so we can push it through our AP?

billing-bot: Invoice reissue request logged. Ticket #BILL-4921 created and assigned to emma_billing. ETA 2 business days.

Emma (Billing): I'll follow up here and DM the PDF once done. If procurement needs a vendor form (W-9 / supplier attestation), let me know — we can attach.

Raj (Acme Procurement): We do not need a W-9. Just the invoice with explicit Order number and VAT. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :thumbsup:

Jamie (Support): Closing the loop — Emma will post the new invoice link here when ready. If anything changes on Acme's side, please @jamie_support or reply in this thread.

Emma (Billing): New invoice issued as INV-2026-4620 with `Order number: ACME-PO-2026-0789`. PDF link: https://files.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2026-4620.pdf (internal link). Please confirm receipt.

Raj (Acme Procurement): Received PDF and submitted to AP. Will update once payment is scheduled. Thanks everyone for the quick help.

Jamie (Support): Great — marking as resolved for now. If payment declines or tax/VAT flags appear, reopen this thread. :white_check_mark:
